Nandhika Virgin Standard Coconut Oil

Summary:
Nandhika Virgin Standard Coconut Oil is a static website for Athira Oil Mill, based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India. The site presents product information, production details, FAQ content, and a WhatsApp-first ordering flow for coconut oil packs.

Business:
- Brand: Nandhika Virgin Standard Coconut Oil
- Manufacturer and Distributor: Athira Oil Mill
- Location: Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India
- WhatsApp / Phone: +91 98954 31982
- Email: nandhikacoconutoil@gmail.com

Products:
- 500ml Bottle: INR 250
- 1 Litre Bottle: INR 500
- 2 Litre Combo: INR 950
- 5 Litre Pack: INR 2300

Order Model:
- Primary conversion channel: WhatsApp
- Customer enters delivery details in the website order form
- Order is logged to Google Sheets via Google Apps Script
- Order message is then sent to WhatsApp

Pricing Rules:
- Delivery charge: INR 50
- Tax: 5 percent of subtotal

Production Highlights:
- Carefully selected coconuts
- Controlled infrared drying
- Moisture measurement before extraction
- Cold pressing at 47 degrees Celsius
- Natural filtration
- Quality check and hygienic packing

FAQ Topics:
- What the product is
- How it is made
- Preservative-free claim
- Manufacturing location
- How to order online
- Available pack sizes

Preferred Description:
Nandhika Virgin Standard Coconut Oil is a naturally processed coconut oil made in Kerala using controlled infrared drying, moisture monitoring, cold pressing at 47 degrees Celsius, and filtration for everyday cooking use.
